Reproducing the paper's results demands genuine understanding of the linearized Thomas-Fermi approach and careful implementation of the minimization protocol, including handling of multiple isomers, which goes beyond off-the-shelf applications.

The optimization step is non-trivial and may require parameter tuning, but overall the orchestration is moderate (4-6 logical stages) with no complex data acquisition or heavy tooling.
